growing_specifications.description: High-value temperate root crop cultivated extensively in high-altitude zones of Benguet (La Trinidad, Atok, Buguias), Mountain Province, and Bukidnon plateau, Philippines. Requires deep, stone-free sandy loam for smooth, straight taproots.

category_why.title: Why is Carrot classified under Root Vegetable?
category_why.summary: Carrot belongs to the Umbelliferae (Apiaceae) family, harvested for its swollen primary taproot that stores massive carbohydrates and carotenoids.
points: Taproot Morphology: Produces a single enlarged storage taproot developing directly from the radicle seedling axis.
Strict Direct Seeding: Unlike transplanted crops, taproots cannot tolerate root disturbance; transplanting bends the root tip, causing irreversible forking.
Soil Texture Sensitivity: Even tiny stones, soil clods, or fresh animal manure split the growing root cap into deformed, multi-legged roots.

harvest_why.title: Why is the harvest maturity set to 90–110 days?
harvest_why.summary: Captures optimal sugar accumulation and maximum beta-carotene pigmentation before the core turns woody or develops hollow heart.
points: Slow Germination & Nursery Emergence (Days 1–21): Slow initial emergence; surface soil moisture must be maintained continuously.
Thinning Window (Days 25–35): Essential thinning to 5–8 cm spacing allows individual taproots to expand sideways.
Taproot Elongation & Deep Penetration (Days 36–65): Taproot mines downward 20–25 cm into deep loose beds.
Root Bulking & Carotene Accumulation (Days 66–95): Roots swell in girth; shoulders expand to 2–4 cm diameter.
Crisp Harvest Window (Days 90–110): Full orange coloration with sweet flavor; lifted with garden fork to prevent snapping.

watering_why.title: Why does Carrot require consistent watering every 2–3 days?
watering_why.summary: Moisture stability is critical to prevent taproot splitting, cracking, and woody fibrous bitterness.
points: Root Splitting Prevention: Sudden downpours after drought cause rapid inner core swelling that ruptures outer carrot skin.
Surface Moisture for Germination: The top 1 cm must stay moist for 14–21 days for the tiny seeds to establish.
Root Rot Defense: Saturated, stagnant soil causes rapid fungal root rot (Pythium, Rhizoctonia, Sclerotinia).

soil_why.title: Why does Carrot require deep stone-free sandy loam with pH 6.0–6.8?
soil_why.summary: Loose, porous soil provides zero physical resistance, allowing smooth downward elongation without bending or forking.
points: Forking Prevention: Rocks, hardpan soil, or fresh manure cause multi-legged 'octopus' carrots.
Nutrient Uptake: pH 6.0–6.8 maximizes potassium for carotene color and boron to prevent internal black heart.

varieties.description: Standard commercial open-pollinated carrot variety in the Philippines. Highly resistant to heat and Alternaria blight, producing sweet cylindrical deep orange roots.
High-yield commercial hybrid with uniform root length, intense carotene coloration, and exceptional shipping firmness.
